info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Data Sources API

items.docs:
Register your data source to the Webex BYODS system. Authentication must happen via a Service App with the scope `spark-admin:datasource_write`.
The schema IDs determine what data types are sent from Webex to the DAP and the expected responses. The schemas can be inspected on developer.webex.com.
Show all data sources registered for this Service App with the scope `spark-admin:datasource_read`.
Show available schemas. No specific scope is needed to retrieve the dataSource schemas, but a valid API token should be presented.

params.name: schemaId
params.description: The unique identifier for the schema.

items.docs: Retrieve details of a specific data source schema by schema id. No specific scope is needed to retrieve the dataSource schemas, but a valid API token should be presented.

params.name: dataSourceId
params.description: The unique identifier for the dataSource.

items.docs:
Show details for a data source, by dataSource id.
To see details for a data source, use the Service App token with the `spark-admin:datasource_read` scope.

params.name: dataSourceId
params.description: The unique identifier for the data source.

items.docs:
Updates a Data Source. The updateable fields are the `audience,` `subject,` `nonce,` `url` and `tokenLifetimeMinutes.`
You can update the `status` from `active` to `disabled` only when providing an `errorMessage` that may be shown to the customer admin in Control Hub. 
Tokens must be regularly updated before their expiration to maintain system uptime.

params.name: dataSourceId
params.description: The unique identifier for the dataSource.

items.docs:
Delete a Data Source, by Data Source ID.

Specify the Data Source ID in the `dataSourceId` parameter in the URI.
